subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw add a channel-visible `/agent <id>` temporary switch for direct chats, and what authorization/session-ownership contract should allow moving a conversation between configured agents?
rationale: The feature changes live message routing across agent workspaces, credentials, tools, memory, and session stores, so automation cannot safely choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Add An Opt-In Secure Switch
options.body: Implement a conversation-level configured-agent binding with explicit target authorization, per-agent session isolation, clear cleanup, and docs/tests for representative channels.

options.title: Keep Existing Focus/Subagent Flows
options.body: Decline direct-chat agent switching and steer users to configured bindings, TUI switching, or thread-bound `/focus` workflows where supported.

options.title: Prototype Through A Plugin Seam
options.body: Keep core unchanged until a plugin or hook proves the UX and identifies any missing core extension API needed for safe routing.

recommendation.title: Add An Opt-In Secure Switch
recommendation.body: Implement a conversation-level configured-agent binding with explicit target authorization, per-agent session isolation, clear cleanup, and docs/tests for representative channels.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily extends multi-agent route ownership and security policy introduced in the central routing work.
